description: This file contains functions for parsing, formatting, and manipulating date and time data within the Git version control system. It includes implementations for converting between timestamp formats, parsing date strings in various formats, and generating human-readable date representations.

methods.name: tm_to_time_t
methods.description: Converts a 'struct tm' to a 'time_t' value without normalizing weekday and yearday.

methods.name: gm_time_t
methods.description: Converts a timestamp and timezone offset into a 'time_t' in GMT.

methods.name: time_to_tm
methods.description: Converts a timestamp and timezone offset into a 'struct tm' in GMT.

methods.name: time_to_tm_local
methods.description: Converts a timestamp into a local 'struct tm'.

methods.name: local_time_tzoffset
methods.description: Calculates timezone offset in minutes for a given local time.

methods.name: local_tzoffset
methods.description: Determines the timezone offset at a specific timestamp.

methods.name: get_time
methods.description: Retrieves current time, either from environment variable or system call.

methods.name: show_date_relative
methods.description: Displays a relative date string (e.g., '2 days ago') based on current time.

methods.name: show_date
methods.description: Formats a timestamp into a human-readable date string based on specified mode.

methods.name: date_mode_from_type
methods.description: Creates a 'date_mode' struct from a date mode type.

methods.name: show_date_normal
methods.description: Generates a detailed, human-readable date string with context-aware hiding of parts.

methods.name: parse_date_basic
methods.description: Parses a date string into a timestamp and offset, supporting various formats.

methods.name: parse_date
methods.description: Parses a date string into a timestamp and formats it into a string buffer.

methods.name: parse_expiry_date
methods.description: Parses an expiry date string into a timestamp.

methods.name: parse_date_format
methods.description: Parses a date format string into a 'date_mode' struct.

methods.name: date_mode_release
methods.description: Frees resources associated with a 'date_mode' struct.

methods.name: datestamp
methods.description: Generates a timestamp string of the current date.
